page.layout: One column of running text, full width, with a centred italic heading and a short heading line. The page number is printed at the top right, and the running head at the top centre. No marginal notes. Edges of the neighbouring page and show-through are left out.

main_text.p: feminam mittentem ramos, tanquam comam amatoriam, ad masculum : confentientemque incoitum,ac turgentem. postquam vero non pertingunt huius quandoque ad matrem rami, argute huic amori subueniunt infitores. Perticis enim ipsam aut viminibus circumligant masculo, & sic percepta voluptate femina curuationem exit, & ad morem veterem ramos reuocat, vtquæ masculi per perticas illas habuerit copiam. absurdum ergo neutiquam, si torpedo quoque piscatores per medium, quod intercedit, lignum, afficiat.
main_text.head: Cur cerui, cum cornua deiecerint, confueta loca fugiant. V.
main_text.p: Pol. Doctum fermonem frater in primis naturæ mihi videris esse, Antisthenes. Sed e mari in terram transire amat fermo,ac in continentem auctor deriuare contemplationem. Ceruos Corinthius iactauit cum cornua abiecerint confueta loca fugere,quasi pudeat illos huius inornatus, quatisperad- est. Aur. Putauerit equidem aliquis ludere forsitan Periclem Polycrates, aut quodammodo corybantiare, vel infanire, qui nugacem hanc quæstionem adferat. ego autem virum admiratus sum, studiumque in eo contemplationis veneror. Sed an videtur ad hanc platanum paulo defidere. cum præsertim densa sit platanus, & quod ad trunci longitudinem vmbramque, perpulchra. Pol. Atqui perge. Aur. Igiturne fili Sofiæ putas, putasne inquam cornu abiicere ceruum? Pol. Dico sane.infinities hoc vidi, quando quidem ætate puer eram, ingenio vero rudior, rebus venatoriis addictus

page.notes: Speaker names "Pot." and "Aut." read as Pol. and Aur.; marked as doubtful. Page number "II" read with [?]. The line "quatisperad-est" is joined from a hyphenated break and may contain a misreading. Heading "V." is a bare letter printed under the heading. Some words in the first lines are uncertain. The text is hard to read at the edges of the scan.
